body_html:
#smallpoems
I am the white space
wrapping Warhols's Banana
eaten and tossed next to
discarded shoes out of frame
by the
crosswalk
while the Hidenburg
burns

A broken zipper stuck on
Sticky Fingers
that bend light in prisms
in photos of an ilmattic
infant ready to die
while others drown by dollars
on a string
pulling Patti's
blank stare
aiming into
@mrchuckd 's crosshairs
firing an
enema at the state
if we each have our song,
what is your album art?
Who will write the liner notes of
your soul?
